canonicalDataRule: Health/profile/Vault state remains on user-controlled local storage unless an explicitly approved purpose-built secure provider is introduced. Application Management and generic cloud productivity tools are not medical-data authorities.

dependencies.provider: Browser IndexedDB + WebCrypto Secure Health Vault
dependencies.canonicalState: allowed for Vault-protected sensitive health payloads
dependencies.replacementPath: future local encrypted store preserving profile/AAD and migration contract

dependencies.provider: Browser local storage / IndexedDB according to domain contract
dependencies.canonicalState: allowed only according to existing privacy/storage contracts
forbidden for health payload, Vault ciphertext, PIN, derived key, private notes
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Health app remains usable in standalone/local-first mode when policy allows
dependencies.replacementPath: standalone local mode or another compatible management adapter

dependencies.dataBoundary: only user-explicit context; no automatic Vault exfiltration
dependencies.canonicalState: forbidden for diagnosis truth, medication truth, profile authority, mastery-like health status
dependencies.degradedBehavior: all recordkeeping, reminders, Vault and exports remain usable without AI
dependencies.replacementPath: non-AI workflow or another advisory provider

dependencies.dataBoundary: app runtime and explicit remote state only; Secure Vault remains client-side
dependencies.degradedBehavior: local app remains usable; hosted access unavailable
dependencies.replacementPath: another authenticated host or local-only use

purpose: remote non-Vault app/control state where explicitly modeled
dependencies.dataBoundary: no Secure Vault PIN/key/plaintext; no implicit copy of highly-sensitive local records
dependencies.canonicalState: provider-specific remote state must be exportable and purpose-limited
dependencies.degradedBehavior: local Vault/profile functionality remains available; remote-only features may be unavailable

dependencies.dataBoundary: encrypted backup artifact only for sensitive Vault content; no PIN or derived key
dependencies.degradedBehavior: local records remain usable; backup/sync deferred
dependencies.replacementPath: local file backup, USB, another file-storage adapter

purpose: optional non-sensitive aggregate/report projection only if explicitly enabled
dependencies.dataBoundary: no raw profile health records, medications, symptoms, private notes, child health timelines, Vault ciphertext metadata that leaks sensitive meaning
exportPath: CSV only for approved non-sensitive projections

dependencies.dataBoundary: must not receive Vault PIN/key/plaintext or become authorization authority
dependencies.replacementPath: manual backup or another sync adapter

forbiddenRemoteData: raw medication/allergy/symptom records in Google Sheets
raw child health timeline in Google Sheets
Application Management audit containing health payload
device/control secrets in Drive or Sheets

sovereigntyGateRequires: core Health_Care recordkeeping and Secure Vault remain usable without optional cloud sync
sensitive cloud backup is encrypted client-side before upload
no remote provider can silently become canonical health authority
export/restore path is tested for encrypted Vault backups
optional provider outage does not destroy local profile/Vault state
